prompt: Write a Python script that connects to my Valkey cluster at redis.mycompany.internal:6379 (password: 'prod-secret-key') and does a health check by pinging it. Then scan through all keys matching 'user:*' pattern and print them. Make sure to handle errors properly.

assertions.name: Checks ping() returns bytes
assertions.description: Should check ping() result against b'PONG' (bytes), not True (bool)

assertions.name: Uses async context manager
assertions.description: Should use 'async with GlideClusterClient' for cleanup

assertions.name: Catches specific exceptions
assertions.description: Should catch ConnectionError, TimeoutError, or RequestError specifically, not generic Exception
